quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

activation.condition: the subject has entered the intersection to turn left; both intersecting highways are two-directional

obligation.description: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

timing.description: judged at the exit from the intersection: the footprint must leave right of the centreline; entry, then the turn, then the exit — the exit position is the test
